en.name: Scapegoat
en.ability: If a player of your alignment is executed, you might be executed instead.
en.flavor: Good evening! Thank you for inviting me to the ball. I'm not from around here, but you sure seem like a friendly bunch, by golly. I'm sure we'll get along just dandy. What's all that rope for?

revisions.v1: If a player of your alignment is executed, you might be executed instead.
